summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Acamas son of Theseus, who fought at Troy and freed his grandmother Aethra.

story.text: Apollodorus names Acamas among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Pylaemenes and before Thersilochus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
